All Classes and Interfaces

Classes
Class
Description
ClientEvents
Recognizes local gestures and synchronizes state before ordinary block-use packets.
ClientSetup
Client-side registration: the three block entity renderers, the key binding, and the resource reload listeners behind render overrides, bar textures, and measured profiles.
ForgeCapabilityAttachment
Attaches ForgeCapabilities.ITEM_HANDLER to the mod's block entities from outside them, through the ordinary Forge capability-attachment event rather than an overridden getCapability.
ForgeEditAuthority
Forge's EditAuthority: a fake player with the shared AutomationActor profile stands in for automation, and claim, protection, and logging mods are given the chance to veto through the ordinary Forge placement and break events.
ForgePlatformServices
Forge implementations of the common platform services.
ForgeRenderPlatform
Forge services used by shared client rendering.
ForgeServerConfig
Forge's native world policy, published into common gameplay on the server thread.
KeyMappings
The mod's key bindings.
ModelMeasurer
Measures the geometry an item will actually produce in the FIXED display context, mirroring the vanilla/Forge ItemRenderer.render pipeline: item-override resolution, applyTransform (which may substitute another model), the renderer's -0.5 origin shift, and all Forge render passes.
ModNetworking
The mod's single channel and the packet registrations on it.
ModRegistry
The mod's registered blocks, block entity types, and sound events, and the Forge registration glue behind them.
RunItemHandler
Forge item-handler view over whichever complete run owns the attached stack block.
SomeStacks
The mod entry point: registers the blocks and block entities, the network channel, and the listeners behind server config loading, sound data, login sync, and commands.
StackInteractionEvents
Applies the gestures vanilla does not route to a stack block's own use method (sneaking torch rotations and clicks on a neighboring block) after Forge's ordinary right-click protection listeners, and keeps a Stack Modifier item use from reaching the held item.
